notes.title: 07/21/2025 Update Log - 1.0.2
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599632/1ccaa3abb2fe55fb49958bbd6d91c7700f6385f0.jpg"]

New Contents:

Add 5 new levels in “Puzzling Maze” mode. Now 20 levels in total for this mode.

Enable the “Free Camera Movement” setting in default.
